correctness.rationale: Reconstructed definitions, all quantifiers, and exact max recurrence at the global maximum. The left word avoids 123 and 213 and has sharp maximum 2^floor(m/2); reverse-layered pair construction attains it. The right factor splits because n blocks earlier entries. A skew value-separated construction proves every recurrence term attainable without violating the two forbidden four-letter patterns. Explicit strict part-weight comparisons reduce all n>=8 maxima to parts 3 and 5; five 3-parts are dominated by three 5-parts. The residue solution is unique, and n<=7 follows from the exact recurrence. The standalone checker independently enumerates n<=9, simulates parking n<=5, and checks the recurrence n<=150; no finite test is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: An exact infinite-family modal-fiber classification is a natural complement to newly studied weighted Schröder parking enumeration. It determines the heaviest individual outcome in a nontrivial permutation pattern class, with explicit attaining constructions and eventual 5-step scaling and exponential growth. The weighted Cartesian-root decomposition and strict integer-composition reductions provide substantive structural information not implied by fiber-product correctness or an arbitrary finite census.
